circle_level_observations.text: The five-person circle captures the main close living contacts explicitly emphasized in the interview: Lourdes, Marisol, Manny, Luis, and Elena.

Other named people, including Rafael, Julio, Carlos, Tania, Rob, cousins, and the niece and nephew, are either deceased, peripheral, work contacts, extended relatives, or represented through Marisol's household, so no replacement or addition is required to maintain a five-member close circle.

The circle correctly excludes a romantic partner, children, roommates, or household members because the interview repeatedly confirms Donovan lives alone, has no children, and is not in a serious cohabiting relationship.
